falsifier_requirement.trigger: FAOSTAT or WOAH snapshot hash is missing or changes during replay; heldout livestock or disease values leak into formula selection; N is below 20; carry-forward or rolling-mean comparator ties or beats the model within uncertainty; country/year disease shuffle is not rejected

incumbent_comparator.baseline_name: FAOSTAT carry-forward and rolling-mean livestock baseline
incumbent_comparator.prediction_rule: predict heldout livestock/health target with last observation carried forward and trailing five-year mean on the same official source snapshot
incumbent_comparator.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

no_fake_closure_policy: Negative source-bound scoring remains a scientific blocker; it cannot be counted as broad superiority.
pass_predicate: pack_status == PASS, material_margin_met == true, no fail-closed status, replay_record PASS.
repair_strategy: If negative, improve the source-bound model/comparator route from canonical evidence rather than weakening the materiality rule.

residual_requirement.formula: absolute residual for count/production rows; aggregate scaled MAE by country/species/year
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: model_scaled_MAE + uncertainty_margin < comparator_scaled_MAE and disease-label controls are rejected

residuals.material_margin_rule: source-bound materialized evidence pack must show OC residual strictly below preregistered comparator residual under the declared uncertainty rule

source.source_authority: WOAH World Animal Health Information System
source.source_name: WOAH World Animal Health Information System

target_variable.extraction_rule: Target values remain hidden until scoring according to the domain-local work order.
target_variable.name: heldout_country_year_livestock_production_and_notifiable_disease_burden
target_variable.unit: FAOSTAT livestock head/count or production quantity; WOAH outbreak/event count

uncertainty_requirement.metric: absolute residual for count/production rows; aggregate scaled MAE by country/species/year
uncertainty_requirement.rule: rolling-origin residual envelope by species and country before target unsealing

why_it_failed: Existing executable evidence pack passes strict material superiority predicates.
